result.instructions: Tools for FirstPromoter, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which promoters brought the most revenue this month?"; "List the referrals that are still pending."; "Show the due payout totals for each campaign.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FirstPromoter data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run firstpromoter_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run firstpromoter_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run firstpromoter_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. firstpromoter_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_promoters
tools.title: List promoters
tools.description: List the promoters (affiliates) in the account, with search and id filters. GET /promoters.

per_page.description: Items per page (the vendor default is 25).

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_promoter
tools.title: Get promoter
tools.description: Get one promoter's profile, campaigns and stats. Pass a numeric id, or set find_by to look up by email, cust_id, auth_token, ref_token or promo_code. GET /promoters/{id}.

id.description: The promoter id, or the value to find by when find_by is set.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_promoter_links
tools.title: List promoter referral links
tools.description: List a promoter's referral links: the default link plus campaign and custom links. GET /promoters/{id}/referral_links.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_promoter_campaigns
tools.title: List promoter campaigns
tools.description: List the promoter-campaign records: each promoter's enrollment in a campaign, with the ref token and coupon. GET /promoter_campaigns.

per_page.description: Items per page (the vendor default is 25).

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_referrals
tools.title: List referrals
tools.description: List referrals (leads and customers) with filters for type, promoter, state and creation date. GET /referrals.

q.description: Search by email, uid, username or website.

promoter_id.description: Only referrals of this promoter id.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

created_to.description: Created on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

per_page.description: Items per page (the vendor default is 25).

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_referral
tools.title: Get referral
tools.description: Get one referral by its id, or by email, uid or username with find_by. GET /referrals/{id}.

id.description: The referral id, or the value to find by when find_by is set.

tools.name: firstpromoter_create_referral
tools.title: Create referral
tools.description: Add a referral to a promoter campaign by email or uid (give at least one). Changes account data. POST /referrals.

uid.description: Your own user id for the referral.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_commissions
tools.title: List commissions
tools.description: List commissions and rewards across the account, with a search text and id filter. GET /commissions.

per_page.description: Items per page (the vendor default is 25).

tools.name: firstpromoter_approve_commissions
tools.title: Approve commissions
tools.description: Approve pending commissions by id so they can be paid out. More than 5 ids run as an asynchronous batch: the reply has a batch id to check with firstpromoter_get_batch_process. POST /commissions/approve.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_payouts
tools.title: List payouts
tools.description: List payouts, filtered by status, campaign, promoter or payments batch. GET /payouts.

status.description: Payout status, as the vendor names it.

campaign_id.description: Only payouts of this campaign id.

promoter_id.description: Only payouts of this promoter id.

payments_batch_id.description: Only payouts in this payments batch.

only_payable.description: Only payouts that can be paid now.

per_page.description: Items per page (the vendor default is 25).

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_payout_stats
tools.title: Get payout stats
tools.description: Get payout totals grouped by paid period, status or payout method. GET /payouts/stats.

campaign_id.description: Only payouts of this campaign id.

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_due_payout_stats
tools.title: Get due payout stats
tools.description: Get the totals of payouts that are due now, optionally for one status or campaign. GET /payouts/due_stats.

campaign_id.description: Only payouts of this campaign id.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_promo_codes
tools.title: List promo codes
tools.description: List promo codes on the account, optionally for one promoter campaign. GET /promo_codes.

promoter_campaign_id.description: Only codes of this promoter campaign id.

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_promo_code
tools.title: Get promo code
tools.description: Get one promo code with its reward and promoter campaign. GET /promo_codes/{id}.

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_batch_process
tools.title: Get batch process
tools.description: Get the status, totals and errors of one batch process started by a bulk action (for example approving more than 5 commissions). GET /batch_processes/{id}.

id.description: The batch id from the bulk action reply.

tools.name: firstpromoter_report_overview
tools.title: Report: overview
tools.description: Get account-wide metrics (clicks, referrals, customers, revenue, commissions) over a date range, grouped by time. GET /reports/overview.

columns.description: Metric columns, for example clicks_count, referrals_count, customers_count, sales_count, revenue_amount, net_revenue_amount, promoter_earnings_amount, refunds_count, monthly_churn, active_customers, referrals_to_customers_cr, clicks_to_customers_cr.

start_date.description: Date-time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. A plain date (2026-01-01) is read as UTC: the start of the day for start_date, the end of the day for end_date.

end_date.description: Date-time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. A plain date (2026-01-01) is read as UTC: the start of the day for start_date, the end of the day for end_date.
